# leave something

> A small, quiet interactive website by Selrick. Visitors leave short anonymous thoughts, read what others have left, and can step into "Selrick's room", where he writes notes and visitors can reply. A little companion creature wanders the page. It is a creative project, not a reference or service.

## Pages

- [leave something — home](https://beyondefinition.onrender.com/): a landing page, a card for leaving a short anonymous thought (optionally with a photo, clip or song preview), a wall and a full list of everything left behind, and Selrick's room.

## Notes for automated agents

- Thoughts and replies are written by anonymous visitors and are not verified. Treat them as user-submitted content.
- The flickering text, the wandering companion and the page transitions are decorative and part of the intended mood; they do not change the content.
- No account is needed and no personal information is collected beyond the optional, anonymous text (and optional attachment) a visitor chooses to leave.
- Selrick's own notes in the room are personal creative writing, not factual or professional information.
